index.methodology: The price is the median across confirmed markets weighted by 24h volume — the value at which cumulative volume passes half. Markets under $1,000 of daily volume, and markets more than 20% away from that median, are left out. Stablecoins (USDT, USDC, DAI and others) are taken as one dollar; quotes in BTC, ETH, BNB and SOL are converted through our own index for those coins. Pairs quoted in euro or other fiat are not counted.
index.manageSubtitle: We check the listings you claim against the exchanges' public APIs every 10 minutes and compute the price from the confirmed ones.
